/feature-flow-lite:feature-flow-lite Password-reset tokens in shop/auth.py never expire and can be reused. Fix that:

- issue_reset_token(username, now=None) and redeem_reset_token(token, now=None); now is a Unix timestamp in seconds and defaults to time.time().
- A token redeemed more than 1800 seconds (30 minutes) after it was issued raises TokenExpired.
- Tokens are single-use: redeeming one a second time raises TokenUsed.
- TokenExpired and TokenUsed subclass InvalidToken; unknown tokens still raise InvalidToken.
- Add tests. ./check.sh must pass.
